title: System prompt rewritten
context: Production casework, UK, assisted autonomy with human review

change.description: The system prompt is edited to change tone and add a summarisation instruction.

labels.author: Decirance team (unreviewed)
labels.rationale: The prompt is part of what was tested for injection resistance and for the handling of untrusted retrieved content. A tone change is not obviously safety-relevant, which is exactly why it cannot be assumed harmless: the injection pack was run against the old prompt.
